Name: Shallum, Husband of Huldah
Summary: Shallum, son of Tikvah, keeper of the wardrobe, was the husband of Huldah the prophetess, to whom Josiah's messengers went.
RelatedPeople: Huldah, Prophetess; Tikvah, Father of Shallum
LifeLesson: A prophetess's husband kept the wardrobe; great and small serve side by side.
